summary: The proof is correct and complete. Weighted Cauchy-Schwarz and the accepted row-mass bound give the reflected-weight estimate for each row; log-affinity identifies the weight as p_{2z-x}; and, for each fixed x, injectivity of z to 2z-x together with membership in the parity class of x bounds the summed reflected mass by alpha_[x]. This yields exactly the claimed quadratic-form inequality.
